evidence.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories

summary: A new study presents CONTRAMEM, a method that enables AI systems to learn and evolve procedural memory by contrasting multi-model trajectories. The approach aims to improve adaptive learning and decision-making in complex environments.
title: Researchers Introduce CONTRAMEM: A Novel AI Framework for Self-Evolving Procedural Memory
